name: rise-flow
displayName: Rise-Flow — Repository Integration & Branch Lifecycle Discipline
description: The holding's generic, git-flow-like repository integration and branch/worktree lifecycle discipline. Capability 1 (Progressive Integration) prevents long-lived local/branch divergence from the upstream default branch before it snowballs: a mandatory pre-flight drift check at the start of any task, concrete drift budgets, escalate-don't-route-around on any blocker, multi-worktree/multi-clone awareness, and a diff-by-diff (never vibes-based) reconciliation procedure once a repo is already past budget. Designed to grow — new capabilities are added over time as additional reference docs under the same package.
author: Marcus Vinícius de Lima (holding)

usage.aiAssistants: Run Capability 1's pre-flight drift check at the start of any task in a git repository (or any of its worktrees), and before creating a new branch/worktree/clone for feature work. If the repo is past the drift budget, stop and surface the exact numbers before proceeding; reconcile per references/c1-progressive-integration.md's diff-by-diff procedure, never by assumption. Read the capability index in SKILL.md before adding any new capability to this package.
usage.engineers: The generic branch/worktree lifecycle discipline every agent-touched repository in the holding operates under, alongside memory-bank and session-handoff.
usage.founders: The standing mechanism that keeps agent-driven feature work from silently drifting away from the shared trunk across long sessions, multiple clones, and parallel worktrees.
